entries.zh: 垂下、下垂；头朝下悬挂
entries.en: hanging downward; to droop, hang down
entries.notes: 主义据汉字'垂'与西语 pendiente à baxo 可定；西语尾词 ô caxar（cazar 抑或 casar）及闽南音后二音节难以确证

entries.zh: 悬挂；依赖、倚靠（依赖属神之事）
entries.en: to hang, be suspended; to depend (on the things of God)
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺，据西语 pender/depender 及对音 hē 推定'倚靠'义；西语 as 疑为 en

entries.zh: 通：贯通、通晓；明白悟解
entries.en: to penetrate, comprehend; to understand thoroughly
entries.notes: 闽南音栏声调号污损(T99)；字义本身明晰，据'通'与西语 penetrar/entender 定

entries.zh: 达：通达洞晓、洞达事物
entries.en: to penetrate through things; to attain understanding
entries.notes: 西语'como la viola/vioda'难以确证；释义据'达'字与 penetrar 义

entries.zh: 因他人言语而心中恼怒不安、心怀气恼
entries.en: to be vexed or offended at what is said; to take words to heart
entries.notes: 声调号污损(T99)且字栏疑[惴/恼]；据西语 penetrar(se) 受言语感触之义拟定

entries.zh: 诣：深造、造诣，学问道行所到之境
entries.en: to penetrate profoundly; attainments, the depth reached in learning
entries.notes: 对音后字疑[ge/lze]；主义据'詣'与西语 penetrar profundamente

entries.zh: 格物：推究事物之理（格物致知，由格物而知其所以然与行事之理）
entries.en: to investigate things so as to infer their principle or mode of operation (ge-wu)
entries.notes: 西语 modo de ero 疑为 modo de obrar（行事之理）；据'格物'字义拟定

entries.zh: 变通：通达权变、随机应变
entries.en: to adapt flexibly, change one's approach; resourceful comprehension
entries.notes: 字栏疑[变/契]，对音 piên-thong 与'变通'密合

entries.zh: 深透：深入透彻
entries.en: to penetrate deeply; thorough and penetrating understanding

entries.zh: 造诣：学识所达之境、造诣深浅
entries.en: attainment in learning; the depth one has reached

entries.zh: 道理通了：道理豁然贯通、由此理而通晓彼理
entries.en: the reasoning has become clear; to grasp one thing through another

entries.zh: 长见识：增长见识、开扩眼界
entries.en: to broaden one's knowledge or insight
entries.notes: 首字疑[长/广]；释义据'增长见识'与西语 induciendo asi 之义

entries.zh: 通时事：通晓时事、明白世事之所发生
entries.en: to be well informed about current affairs; to grasp what has happened
entries.notes: 西语 alcança llo suzo 疑为 alcanza lo sucedido（明白所发生之事）

entries.zh: 通透：通透彻底、明达无碍
entries.en: thoroughly clear and penetrating; to see through completely

entries.zh: 识破：看破他人内心或底细隐情
entries.en: to see through another's inner mind or hidden designs

entries.zh: 省破：省悟识破、看透内里
entries.en: to discern and see through the inside of something
entries.notes: 声调号污损(T99)、字疑[sia/sin]；据西语'洞察内里'与'破'字拟定

entries.zh: 明白他人所言、自己听懂话意
entries.en: to understand what is said; to comprehend speech oneself
entries.notes: 声调号污损(T99)、字样疑[咀/ʒa]；释义主要据西语栏 penetrar lo que dice, entendello el mismo

entries.zh: 话通了：话语已听懂、语言贯通明白
entries.en: to have grasped the language; the speech becomes intelligible

entries.zh: 透：穿透、透过
entries.en: to penetrate; to pass through

entries.zh: 分晓：知晓、明白；心中思量、念头
entries.en: thought (Sp. pensamiento); to know, discern clearly
entries.notes: 西语 pensamiento（思虑）配'分晓'，取'心中明白/思量'义，属原书特别对应

entries.zh: 念头：心中所起之念、想法（少向人言说者）
entries.en: thoughts, notions of the mind (seldom voiced)
